summary: Phase 4 Client Portal (PIN auth) tested. Backend endpoints for register/login/me/forgot-pin/brute-force lockout all validated via curl. Frontend UI renders correctly with all required elements: login+register tabs, marketing consent unchecked by default, forgot-PIN link, portal link on guest booking page, 5-attempts lockout warning. Guest booking flow at /book/org_demo001 loads independently. Backend brute-force protection triggers 429 at attempt 5 with 15-minute lockout, then rate-limiter kicks in.
passed: POST /api/public/clients/login valid credentials -> 200 sets session cookie
GET /api/public/clients/me with session -> 200 returns client + appointments
POST /api/public/clients/login invalid PIN -> 401 with 'Invalid phone number or PIN'
Brute-force protection: 5th failed login returns 429 with 15-min lockout message
Rate limiter fires after 5/min with 'Rate limit exceeded'
Portal auth UI loads with Iniciar Sesión / Registrarse tabs and all fields
Marketing consent checkbox present and UNCHECKED by default (opt-in per spec)
'Después de 5 intentos fallidos' warning displayed on login page
'¿Olvidaste tu PIN?' link present on login screen
'¿Ya tienes cuenta? Inicia sesión' link rendered on /book/:orgId booking page
Guest booking page /book/org_demo001 renders services list independently

failed.issue: Documented test credentials +573001234567/PIN 1234 do not exist in DB (login returns 401 'Invalid phone number or PIN'). This is not an app bug but a data seeding gap — /app/memory/test_credentials.md claims this account exists but it does not.
failed.evidence: curl login with +573001234567/1234/org_demo001 -> 401 Invalid phone number or PIN

failed.issue: Portal auth form inputs lack data-testid attributes (all inputs have testid=None). Makes automated testing brittle; had to rely on placeholder text and index-based selection.
failed.evidence: Playwright inspection: input[0..3] all report data-testid=None

action_items: Optional: seed the demo client +573001234567/1234 referenced in test_credentials.md, OR update the doc to note that this account must be registered first.

Optional: add data-testid attributes to ClientPortalAuth form inputs and buttons (phone-input, name-input, pin-input, marketing-checkbox, register-submit, login-submit, register-tab, login-tab) to improve future test stability.
notes: UI login attempt with newly-registered account failed because that account got locked by the brute-force validation test earlier (15-min lockout, which is correct backend behavior). Change-PIN, delete-account, cancel-appointment, and reset-PIN-with-token flows were NOT executed end-to-end via UI due to first-finish latency budget — deferred to full QA. Backend endpoints for those exist per spec but were not directly hit in this pass.
